set.body:
Objective
Deliver and compare two scientifically explicit engines:
1. GazeWeave-Transport v2 for symmetric coverage-conditioned relational transport.
2. GazeWeave-Replay for directional encoding-to-recall inference.

Primary endpoint
Held-out gaze_info_bits = log2(p_true / prior_true). odds_bits may remain secondary. Coverage, selection, spatial fidelity, chronology, warp, rank, calibration, and stability are diagnostics rather than separate primary outcomes.

Scientific boundaries
- Separate replay coverage, selected mass, correspondence, and item evidence.
- Preserve cross-fitted, candidate-invariant registration.
- Keep isotropic contraction plus participant/session translation as the default nuisance policy; affine warp is sensitivity-only.
- Do not call a regularized coupling a posterior. Only Replay posterior quantities receive probabilistic uncertainty language.
- Do not claim superiority or select a default before synthetic and real-data gates.
- Preserve Transport for genuinely symmetric comparisons even if Replay becomes the encoding-to-recall default.

Done when
The shared contract is frozen; both engines and the calibrated evidence layer are implemented; strong registered/calibrated baselines are run under identical folds; synthetic and real positive/negative controls pass declared gates; the default-engine decision is recorded; documentation and package checks reproduce the bounded claims.
set.title: GazeWeave v2 and probabilistic replay evidence program
